//: LOCAL DEV ONLY. NEVER COMMIT REAL VALUES. This file is git-ignored by Functions templates; keep it that way. In Azure, set these as the Function App's application settings instead.

Values.//ServiceBusConnection: Connection string OR (preferred) '<namespace>.servicebus.windows.net' to use identity-based connection. For the latter add ServiceBusConnection__fullyQualifiedNamespace below instead.
Values.//WAREWOLF_SERVICEBUS_TRIGGER_QUEUE: Queue name WorkflowQueueTrigger binds to via %AppSetting% indirection. Must match Deploy-WwExecutionServiceBusWorker.ps1's -ServiceBusQueueName in Azure.
Values.//WwExecution settings: Bound to WwExecutionOptions. Double-underscore maps to nested config keys.
Values.//Scope: Optional. Defaults to api://{ResourceAppId}/.default when omitted.
Values.//Local client-secret fallback: Set UseClientSecretFallback=true to authenticate with a daemon app (client id + secret) instead of Managed Identity. In Azure leave this false and rely on MI.
Values.//ManagedIdentityClientId: Optional user-assigned MI client id (Azure). Leave blank for system-assigned.
